Let's install JDK 25 (Amazon Corretto 25 is in the Dockerfile; apt might not have 25 — Ubuntu 22.04's apt only goes up to 21; download Corretto 25 or Temurin 25 from adoptium). Let's grab Corretto 25 from AWS (the Dockerfile uses amazoncorretto:25).

Note the Gradle error: "Dependency requires at least JVM runtime version 25. This build uses a Java 21 JVM." So run Gradle with JDK 25. Downloading Corretto 25.
